title: EV Charger Installation Work Order Form
subtitle: An original ev charger installation workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete ev charger installation work order form for the electric vehicle charging site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The charging deployment coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: EV charger installation work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: EV charger installation asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact electric vehicle charging site and define work that is included and excluded.

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Verify charger, circuit, panel, and parking-space identities
Coordinate planned outage and affected-party notification
Install mounting, foundation, or wall support within approved scope
Install raceway, conductors, disconnect, and circuit identification
Complete grounding, bonding, and protective-device checks
Install impact protection, signage, striping, and cord management
Configure network, payment, access control, and remote monitoring
Perform qualified electrical test and representative charging session
Document as-built route, settings, labels, and equipment serials
Handoff operating instructions, support path, and open limitations

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: EV charger installation pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not an energized-work permit or energy-control procedure. Stop when exposed parts, unknown circuits, failed protection, water intrusion, heat, smoke, or impact damage is present. A qualified and authorized person must control isolation, testing, commissioning, and return to service under current site procedures and applicable requirements. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: EV charger installation work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: EV charger installation exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Exposed or damaged energized component, conductor, connector, or enclosure
Arcing, smoke, abnormal heat, burning odor, or repeated protective trip
Water intrusion, standing water, flood exposure, or damaged seals
Vehicle impact, unstable mounting, sharp edge, or falling equipment
Uncontrolled circuit, unknown backfeed, or incomplete energy isolation
Grounding, bonding, or protective-device result outside approved criteria
Pedestrian, accessible-route, traffic, or cord trip exposure
Work beyond the assigned qualified person's authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not an energized-work permit or energy-control procedure. Stop when exposed parts, unknown circuits, failed protection, water intrusion, heat, smoke, or impact damage is present. A qualified and authorized person must control isolation, testing, commissioning, and return to service under current site procedures and applicable requirements.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: EV charger installation decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Electric vehicle charging site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
